scenes.topic_description:
Situation: At the airport check-in desk, the learner is taking a first flight to London and needs the boarding pass and basic flight information before going to security and passport control. This is an early airport interaction where missing key details could cause confusion later.
Learner: Traveller. Partner: Airline agent.
Not in this scene: security instructions, passport questions, border entry purpose, transport after arrival.
scenes.image_prompt: airport check-in counter with suitcase scale and boarding pass printer, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

must_say: give your passport — slot: the document

answer how long you will stay — slot: the length of stay
answer where you will stay — slot: the place
ask whether everything is okay — slot: none
confirm you understand where to go next — slot: the place
must_understand: asks where you are travelling to
asks the purpose of your trip
asks how long you will stay and where you will stay
says you can go through or tells you where to go next
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: At passport control, the learner speaks to a border officer before entering or leaving through the border point. It is the learner's first time flying to London, and this is the interaction they are most worried about because they must answer clearly and stay calm.
Learner: Traveller. Partner: Border officer.
Not in this scene: check-in, baggage questions, security screening, finding the gate, transport in the city.
scenes.image_prompt: airport passport control booths with queue barriers and officer desks, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

must_understand: asks where you want to go

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: After arrival, the learner needs to leave the airport and reach London using public transport. This interaction matters because the learner must choose the right route, buy the correct ticket, and find the correct platform or stop in an unfamiliar place.
Learner: Traveller. Partner: Station staff.
Not in this scene: check-in, passport questions, hotel check-in, asking for tourist information.
